description_en: Queries the configuration of an HTTP listener
name: DescribeLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

AclId.description_en:
The ID of the access control policy group bound to the listener.

This parameter is returned when the value of AclStatus is on
AclId.description_zh:
监听绑定的访问策略组ID。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，返回该参数

AclStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether access control is enabled. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
AclStatus.description_zh:
是否开启访问控制功能。取值：
on：是。
off：否

AclType.description_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

white: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access your service. Enabling a whitelist poses some risks to your services. After a whitelist is enabled, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the SLB listener.

 If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

black: All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are not forwarded. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to deny access from specific IP addresses.

 If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

This parameter is required when the value of AclStatus is on
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制类型：

white： 仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。

 如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black： 来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。

 如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数必选

BackendServerPort.description_en: The backend port used by the instance

Bandwidth.description_en:
The peak bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s.

-1: The peak bandwidth is not limited.

1 to 5120: The peak bandwidth of the listener. The sum of the peak bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance
Bandwidth.description_zh:
监听的带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。

-1：不限制带宽峰值。

1~5120：监听的带宽峰值，所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值

Cookie.description_en: The cookie configured on the server

CookieTimeout.description_en: The cookie timeout period. Unit: seconds

ForwardPort.description_en:
The Redirection Port used to redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS.

This parameter is not returned if the value of ListenerForward is off
ForwardPort.description_zh:
HTTP至HTTPS的监听转发端口。

如果ListenerForward的值为off，该参数不显示

Gzip.description_en:
Indicates whether `Gzip` compression is enabled to compress specific types of files. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
Gzip.description_zh:
是否开启`Gzip`压缩，对特定文件类型进行压缩。取值：
on：是。
off：否

HealthCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether health checks are enabled. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
HealthCheck.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
on：是。
off：否

HealthCheckConnectPort.description_en:
The port used for health checks.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckConnectPort.description_zh:
健康检查的端口。

当HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckDomain.description_en: The domain name used for health checks

HealthCheckHttpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code that indicates a healthy health check
HealthCheckHttpCode.description_zh: 健康检查正常的HTTP状态码

HealthCheckInterval.description_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds
HealthCheckInterval.description_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔，单位：秒

HealthCheckMethod.description_en:
The health check method used for HTTP health checks of the listener. Valid values: head or get.

This parameter is returned when the value of HealthCheck is on
HealthCheckMethod.description_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：head或get。

HealthCheck值为on时，返回该参数

HealthCheckTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for each health check response. Unit: seconds
HealthCheckTimeout.description_zh: 每次健康检查响应的超时时间，单位：秒

HealthCheckURI.description_en:
The URI used for health checks.

The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URI cannot be only a forward slash (/) but must start with a forward slash (/)
HealthCheckURI.description_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。

长度限制为1~80，只能使用字母、数字和短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%），半角问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）这些字符。URI不能只为正斜线（/），但必须以正斜线（/）开头

IdleTimeout.description_en:
The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 15. Valid values: 1 to 60.

If no access request is received within the specified timeout period, Server Load Balancer temporarily breaks the current connection and restarts the connection when the next request arrives
IdleTimeout.description_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间，单位：秒。

默认值为15，取值范围为1~60。

在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到下一次请求来临时重新建立新的连接

ListenerForward.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection is enabled for the listener. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
ListenerForward.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP至HTTPS的监听转发。取值：
on：是。
off：否

ListenerPort.description_en: The frontend port used by the instance

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The request timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60. Valid values: 1 to 180.

If no response is received from the backend server within the specified timeout period, Server Load Balancer stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
RequestTimeout.description_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。

默认值为60，取值范围为1~180。

在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

wrr: Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests than those with lower weights.

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence
Scheduler.description_zh:
调度算法。取值：

wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器

SecurityStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the security status is enabled. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
SecurityStatus.description_zh:
是否开启安全状态。取值：
on：是。
off：否

Status.description_en:
The current status of the listener. Valid values:

running: The listener is running normally.

stopped: The listener is stopped
Status.description_zh:
当前监听的状态。取值：

running：表示监听正常运行。

stopped：表示监听停止

StickySession.description_en:
Indicates whether session persistence is enabled. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
StickySession.description_zh:
是否开启会话保持。取值：
on：是。
off：否

StickySessionType.description_en:
The method used to handle cookies. Valid values: insert or server.

insert: Insert cookie.

  When a client accesses Server Load Balancer for the first time, Server Load Balancer inserts a cookie into the response (inserts SERVERID into the HTTP or HTTPS response). The next time the client sends a request with this cookie, Server Load Balancer forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.

server: Rewrite cookie.

  When Server Load Balancer discovers that a user has defined a custom cookie, it rewrites the original cookie. The next time the client sends a request with the new cookie, Server Load Balancer forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.

This parameter is required when the value of StickySession is on
StickySessionType.description_zh:
Cookie的处理方式。

取值：insert或server。

insert：植入Cookie。

  客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie（即在HTTP或HTTPS响应报文中插入SERVERID），下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

server：重写Cookie。

  负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。

当StickySession的值为on时，必须指定该参数

VServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the bound vServer group

XForwardedFor.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-For` header is used to retrieve the real IP address of the client. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor.description_zh:
是否开启通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段的方式获取来访者真实IP。取值：
on：是。
off：否

XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort.description_en:
Indicates whether the `XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort` header is used to retrieve the port of the client that accesses the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort.description_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否

XForwardedFor_SLBID.description_en:
Indicates whether the `SLB-ID` header is used to retrieve the ID of the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor_SLBID.description_zh:
是否通过`SLB-ID`头字段获取负载均衡实例ID。取值：
on：是。
off：否

XForwardedFor_SLBIP.description_en:
Indicates whether the `SLB-IP` header is used to retrieve the virtual IP address (VIP) requested by the client. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor_SLBIP.description_zh:
是否通过`SLB-IP`头字段获取客户端请求的VIP（Virtual IP address）。取值：
on：是。
off：否

XForwardedFor_SLBPORT.description_en:
Indicates whether the `XForwardedFor_SLBPORT` header is used to retrieve the listener port of the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor_SLBPORT.description_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_SLBPORT`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否

XForwardedFor_proto.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header is used to retrieve the listener protocol of the SLB instance. Valid values:
on: Yes.
off: No
XForwardedFor_proto.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
on：是。
off：否
